say:1:1541106001:1.text: Easy. You just challenge the last chief and win the duel.
say:1:1541106001:1.source_cn: 很简单。向前任首领发起决斗，然后胜过他。
say:1:1541106001:1.male: Easy. You just challenge the last chief and win the duel.
say:1:1541106001:1.female: Easy. You just challenge the last chief and win the duel.

say:2:1541106002:1.text: But me? I didn't go through all that.
say:2:1541106002:1.male: But me? I didn't go through all that.
say:2:1541106002:1.female: But me? I didn't go through all that.

say:4:1541106003:1.text: I remember Modra telling me the last chief died in battle.
say:4:1541106003:1.source_cn: 我记得，蒙多曾说过，前任首领是战死的。

say:5:1541106004:0.text: Yeah, the last chief died fighting. The Wildborn had no choice but to decide the next chief by lineage and ability.
say:5:1541106004:0.source_cn: 对。前任首领战死，雅库伯尔只能通过血脉和能力来确定继任者。

choice_prompt:6:1541106004.text: Yeah, the last chief died fighting. The Wildborn had no choice but to decide the next chief by lineage and ability.
choice_prompt:6:1541106004.source_cn: 对。前任首领战死，雅库伯尔只能通过血脉和能力来确定继任者。

say:8:1541106006:0.text: Being chief isn't exactly a reward.
say:8:1541106006:0.source_cn: 当首领，不是一件好差事。

say:9:1541106007:0.text: The best warriors should be out there hunting prey, not stuck in the Great Treehouse buried in scrolls all day.
say:9:1541106007:0.source_cn: 优秀的战士该去追逐猎物，不该被困在主树厅里，整天和枯燥...

say:10:1541106008:0.text: Only the priestesses and the sickly ones bother with reading and writing.
say:10:1541106008:0.source_cn: 只有巫祭，还有因为体弱，不能成为战士的人，才会学习文字。

say:11:1541106009:1.text: But someone has to pass down the ancestors' words. So the chief's family learns the scrolls. If they can handle the writing, they can probably handle leading too.
say:11:1541106009:1.source_cn: 但是，为了先祖的话语得到传承，前首领的后代会学习文字。...

choice_prompt:12:1541106009.text: But someone has to pass down the ancestors' words. So the chief's family learns the scrolls. If they can handle the writing, they can probably handle leading too.
choice_prompt:12:1541106009.source_cn: 但是，为了先祖的话语得到传承，前首领的后代会学习文字。他们的血脉也可以证明他们的头脑。

say:13:1541106010:1.source_cn: 我阿娘的阿娘，曾是雅库伯尔的首领。

say:14:1541106011:1.text: She always told me I was meant to lead the Wildborn to something greater.
say:14:1541106011:1.source_cn: 她希望我能率领雅库伯尔，获得更辉煌的成就。

say:15:1541106012:1.text: So when they gathered all the descendants of former chiefs... well, I stood out. No question.
say:15:1541106012:1.source_cn: 所以，当所有先代首领的子孙聚集在一起，毫无疑问，我最出众。

say:16:1541106013:1.text: You've been chief for a while now. Has anyone ever challenged you to a duel, Kordan?
say:16:1541106013:1.source_cn: 戈丹也成为首领很久了。有人向你发起决斗吗？

say:18:1541106015:1.text: Still, I am curious who'll be the next to lead the Wildborn after me.
say:18:1541106015:1.source_cn: 我倒想瞧瞧，能成为雅库伯尔下一任首领的人，究竟会是谁。

choice:12:0:1.text: So one of your ancestors was chief?
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 这么说，你的祖先曾经是首领？
choice:12:0:1.male: So one of your ancestors was chief?
choice:12:0:1.female: So one of your ancestors was chief?

say:20:1541106005:1.text: Strength matters. But a sharp mind matters more.
say:20:1541106005:1.source_cn: 力量很重要，但头脑，更重要。

choice:6:1:2.text: I thought the heir was chosen by duel.
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 我还以为要通过对决来确定人选
choice:6:1:2.male: I thought the heir was chosen by duel.
choice:6:1:2.female: I thought the heir was chosen by duel.
